# Skarp

> Skarp is a free, open-source (MIT) command-line tool that measures C# code health with Roslyn. It gives each file a health score from 1 to 10, reports findings (complex, long or deeply nested methods, large types, long parameter lists, duplicate code, and with a solution coupling, god classes and unused code), finds git-history hotspots, keeps baselines and a CI gate, writes SARIF, and offers hooks and an MCP server for AI coding agents (experimental). Install with `dotnet tool install -g Skarp` (.NET 10).

## Start here

- [README](README.md): what Skarp is, install, first run, links to everything.
- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md): install, first run, reading the output.
- [Installation](docs/installation.md): .NET tool, release archives, requirements.

## Reference

- [Rules](docs/rules.md): every rule, what it measures, how to improve flagged code.
- [Presets](docs/presets.md): threshold presets and their sources.
- [Explain](docs/explain.md): the `skarp explain` command.
- [Settings](docs/settings.md): settings levels, .skarp.json, per-path overrides.
- [Health score](docs/health-score.md): how the 1 to 10 score is computed.
- [Baselines and gate](docs/baselines-and-gate.md): baselines, --new-only, the CI gate.
- [History and hotspots](docs/history-and-hotspots.md): git history and hotspot tables.
- [Semantic tier](docs/semantic-tier.md): solution-level analysis (coupling, unused code, cycles).
- [Coverage](docs/coverage.md): Cobertura coverage reports.
- [Conditional compilation](docs/conditional-compilation.md): how #if code is handled.
- [Reports and SARIF](docs/reports-and-sarif.md): text, JSON, Markdown, GitHub and SARIF output.
- [Contracts](docs/contracts.md): JSON schemas, exit codes, settings keys, finding ids.

## AI coding agents

- [Check and agents](docs/check-and-agents.md): skarp check, skarp show and the MCP server (experimental).
- [Claude Code](docs/agents/claude-code.md): hooks and MCP for Claude Code (experimental).
- [Git hooks](docs/git-hooks.md): checks on each commit (experimental).
